authority: Coordinator adopts independently reviewed compiler-profile amendment; supersedes only budget.json parity.profile when the fixed selector chooses C or T

selector.rule: Choose T only if T/C and T/G both pass every predeclared VM0 usefulness, variability and control gate; otherwise choose C only if C/G passes every gate; otherwise retain G

matched_reference.if_G: Original matched GCC O3 profile and qualified upstream
matched_reference.if_C_or_T: One fresh unchanged upstream build with exact selected Clang implementation/dependencies and same computed/tail backend, effective O3 and GIL policy; debug, stats, JIT, tier2, PGO and LTO disabled

forbidden_credit: Clang fork compared to GCC upstream
missing invalid inconclusive or critical-correctness-failing evidence
reason: The user requires parity of the coherent interpreter/collector package; fair matched compiler/backend comparison avoids an arbitrary GCC-only restriction while retaining the original hard decision
